tutorial.body.create: Gravity Desktop creates one empty File Core on first launch. Drag files onto it to build a visual relationship group. The files remain in their original locations.
tutorial.body.collection: Select Create File Core on the top control bar or the tray menu. Move the pointer to an empty location and click once to place it. Press Esc or right-click to cancel.
tutorial.body.open: Click a File Core to expand it, then double-click a file to open it from its original path. Drag the divider to resize the workspace.

tutorial.completed: Tutorial complete. Start organizing your workspace.

safety_library.desktop_entry_description: Gravity Desktop safe file library. It remains directly accessible if the app cannot start.
safety_library.information_contents:
Gravity Desktop Safe Files

This folder contains the real files managed by Gravity Desktop. They are not extra copies.

Under normal circumstances, use and manage these files through Gravity Desktop.

Use "Restore all files to the Windows Desktop" only when Gravity Desktop cannot start, the workspace cannot be displayed, or files cannot be found in a Core.

Do not manually delete, move, or rename managed files here. Doing so can break file relationships and recovery records.
